'''Tasandra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the start of the [[Galactic War]]. Part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces that [[Attack on the Fortitude|attacked]] the [[Fortitude (Valor-class)|''Fortitude'']] in [[3642 BBY]], she fell in battle with the [[Rift Alliance]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] and the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], though only the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survived the fight.<ref name="TOR" />
